ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black region extending from the base towards the median notch; white lateral fields containing irregular black mottling and discrete circular spots concentrated near the central black/white interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire upper trailing edge with sharp peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white barnacle shells (Coronula diadema) localized on both distal tips and along the lateral leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint dark linear scratches visible on the white pigmented sections of the left lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization covering the distal-most points of both lobes; minor irregular trailing edge fraying.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle fringe along the lateral margins creating a highly textured perimeter against the water background.
